purpose: Use only already-exposed V5-V7 economics evidence to characterize persistent meeting-level full-loss tails while the preregistered V8 run is computing. This diagnostic cannot alter V8 because V8 was frozen before this analysis.
diagnosis: The persistent full-loss tail spans four distinct fixed folds, so it is not localized to a single fold.
The persistent full-loss tail spans 333m, 400m and 500m meetings, so exposed evidence does not support deleting one circumference class as a rescue rule.
Meeting identity is outcome-exposed information and must not become a future purchase-selection feature.
If V8 also fails, any successor should target preregistered PRE-only uncertainty/regime attributes that can generalize across meetings, not outcome-conditioned meeting exclusion.
anti_cherry_pick_boundary: Do not remove the listed meetings, folds, venues or circumference classes merely because they performed poorly. Any successor hypothesis must be separately versioned and preregistered before scoring.
